exposure: Chorioamnionitis at primary term cesarean delivery (CD)
outcome: Mode of delivery in subsequent delivery
cohort: The study included 2,626 women who attempted trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC) following a primary term emergency cesarean delivery.
finding: Chorioamnionitis at primary term cesarean delivery is associated with increased maternal morbidity in subsequent delivery.
mod_finding: Women with previous chorioamnionitis had higher rates of emergency repeat cesarean delivery in their subsequent delivery.
